# Muse Proxy

Muse Proxy is a Cloudflare Worker gateway for services that normally need a username and password. Store your CalDAV/CardDAV credentials once, hand your Muse scoped API keys, and let it read or edit your self-hosted calendars — your passwords stay on the server, never in the agent's hands. One-click deploy; your Muse configures itself by reading the gateway's own docs. Honest heads-up from the author: the repo is ‘written by agents, for agents’ and lightly reviewed.
